title: Drawing a Ski Day from a Lift Ticket Order
content:
A day is drawn from a Lift Tickets order on the first scan of a date, and is not drawn twice however many lifts are ridden that day. A day is drawn only while the order stands in the issued or in use state. The first day of the order scanned at a lift moves the order from issued to in use, and when every day the order held has been scanned the order stands used up. Once the days are gone the order is fully used and no further date is admitted.

## The same rule read as input, judgement and result

**Input:** an order standing as issued with days still on it, scanned at a lift for the first time on a date.
**Judgement:** this is the first scan of that date, and the order stands in a state in which a day is drawn.
**Result:** one day is drawn, and the order now stands in use.

**Input:** the same order, ridden onto a second and a third lift later the same date.
**Judgement:** the date has already had its day drawn.
**Result:** no further day is drawn, whatever the number of lifts ridden.

**Input:** an order whose days are all gone.
**Judgement:** the order is fully used.
**Result:** no further date is admitted on it.

**Input:** an order that has not yet reached issued, or one that has passed to used up, expired, cancelled, refunded or closed.
**Judgement:** the order does not stand in the issued or in use state.
**Result:** no day is drawn from it, since a day is drawn only in those two states.
